item.title: Fall 2026 Semiannual Report to Congress
item.description:
This report was submitted to the acting Comptroller General in accordance with Section 5 of the Government Accountability Office (GAO) Act of 2008. The report summarizes the activities of GAO's Office of Inspector General (OIG) for the 6-month reporting period ending September 30, 2026.
During this reporting period, the OIG closed nine GAO-related investigations, opened seven new GAO-related investigations, and processed 76 substantive hotline complaints. The OIG also published three engagement reports, continued work on six engagements, and initiated two engagements. The OIG is taking steps to strengthen its independence and seeks a budget floor similar to that of other OIGs to ensure impactful oversight over GAO.
For more information, contact the OIG at oig@gao.gov.
